name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer focused on its flagship Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a large mineral resource of over 100 Mt grading 65 g/t silver and 0.62 g/t gold, making it one of the largest undeveloped silver deposits in Latin America. The company is in the advanced exploration and pre-development stage, working toward a final construction decision expected in 2026 under Argentina's RIGI investment regime.
